text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaa.
My heart's starting to pound...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I-It might not be okay...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Because I decided on my own...
that I wanted to race Teio, and chose this race myself."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Losing like this would be totally pathetic.
Though honestly, even thinking like this is already so uncool.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What the heck is that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you keep repeating that.
Don't you have any wittier words to say, desu?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, yeah. Thanks.
I can't completely believe it yet, though..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I intend... not to forget
that you think of me that way, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Employee
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, do you have a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, yes, here you go!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Employee
text_block_list.text:
There has been a change in the race entrants,
so I've come to inform you.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Employee
text_block_list.text:
“—Tokai Teio has been
scratched from the race.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
Teio did!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Why...

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Employee
text_block_list.text:
I don't have all the details yet...
I only heard she got injured right before it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Injured...

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Employee
text_block_list.text:
I'll just let you know for now!
Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No way... Teio isn't here...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if she's alright. Is it really that bad?
I mean, like..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, my brain is getting all tangled up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible! I mean...
I worked so hard to steel myself for this fight.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Oh crap...
What do I do, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whose back am I supposed
to chase today...?

Nice Nature had always aimed for Tokai Teio.
I can understand her feeling lost now that her goal is gone, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But if I just run...
Even Teio had a strategy—
choice_data_list: Teio isn't racing in this one.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"T-That's...
true, but..."
choice_data_list: That's precisely why you've gotta win!
That's precisely why you have to win!

text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature is currently
focusing way too much on Tokai Teio.

Having a target helps you grow, but
fixating on it will inevitably lead to stagnation.
To look ahead, she needed to realize that herself.
choice_data_list: Let's just focus on running our own race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: My... race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I panicked a bit too much.
Ugh, how unsightly of me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm still confused, but...
I won't run a shameful race. I promise.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I really don't want to look any more uncool than this!
